manifest_row.title: This 'Docudramedy' Finds Laughs in the Horror of Climate Change

screening.main_topic: An interview with filmmaker Sean Devlin about his film on a Philippine family recovering from a typhoon and the themes of climate justice, grief, and responsibility.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change and its impacts are a major focus of the interview, including deadly storms, unequal vulnerability, historical responsibility, and the human costs of climate change.
screening.reason: Although framed around the film, the text repeatedly and meaningfully discusses climate change, its impacts, and related political and social debates.
